headline: Executive order aims to help businesses owned by service-disabled veterans win more federal contracts and subcontracts.
what_it_does: This 2004 order directs federal agencies to expand chances for businesses owned by veterans with service-connected disabilities to get federal contracts and subcontracts. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, goals, or deadlines it sets for agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Small businesses owned by service-disabled veterans
who_it_affects.how: They may get more opportunities to compete for and win federal contracts and subcontracts.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that buy goods and services
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps to increase contracting with service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.

who_it_affects.group: Prime contractors working for the federal government
who_it_affects.how: They may see efforts to increase subcontracting with service-disabled veteran-owned businesses.
